name: Cream Cheese and Pepper Jelly Puff Pastry Tart

ingredients.name: egg beaten lightly with 1 teaspoon water, for egg wash

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Set a 13-by-46-cm rimmed baking sheet upside down on middle rack to preheat. Line another 13-by-46-cm baking sheet with parchment paper.

On a lightly floured surface, roll puff pastry into a 9-by-30-cm rectangle. Pick up the pastry by carefully rolling it around your rolling pin, using a bench scraper to lift it cleanly from the work surface, if needed. Unroll it onto the parchment-lined baking sheet.

Using an offset spatula, spread the cream cheese evenly across puff pastry, leaving a 2.5-cm border on all sides. Using the tip of the spatula, create small swoops and divots. Add pepper jelly in a similar fashion, swirling it into the cream cheese to create a textured surface. Using a paring knife, score a 2.5-cm border around perimeter of the cream cheese and pepper jelly filling, and brush with egg wash. Lightly season border with salt and pepper. Freeze the tart until firm, about 15 minutes.

Place baking sheet with tart on top of preheated baking sheet and bake until edges are deep golden brown and puffed, and the cream cheese and pepper jelly have melted together and thickened slightly, 14 to 16 minutes.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds, if desired. Cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Using a serrated knife, cut into rectangles. Serve immediately.

description: This cream cheese and pepper jelly tart is easy enough for casual gatherings and elegant enough for holidays and celebrations.
notes: Optional or for serving: Thinly sliced scallions, for garnish (optional); Toasted white sesame seeds, for garnish (optional)
author: Laura Manzano
